facts.fact: Botswana's Minister of Trade and Entrepreneurship told Parliament that the Botswana Bureau of Standards (BOBS) developed national quality standards on school uniforms, which are voluntary; the document gives no date for the body's creation and names no IT or data standard, so it is dated by its publication date.

systems.owner: Ministry of Trade and Entrepreneurship (minister answered for it)

note: The school uniform standard is a non-IT standard and the National Quality Policy is a quality policy, so neither is a published or certification fact; no certification is mentioned.

facts.fact: The Botswana Bureau of Standards (BOBS) publishes a Standardization Annual Work Programme for national standards-development projects, Issue 341 covering 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027, updated 16 April 2026; the page names no information technology or data standard.

note: Index page only; the work-programme PDFs were not captured, so no IT or data standard and no certification is stated.

facts.fact: The Standards Act (Act 16 of 1995, commenced 1 August 1996) establishes the Botswana Bureau of Standards as a body corporate and a Standards Council, and charges the Bureau with preparing and publishing Botswana Standards; it names no information technology or data standard.

note: Statute is not IT-specific; its standards marks licensing and recognition of inspection agencies for product and quality system certification are general quality infrastructure, so no certification fact is recorded.
